vo_open.text: This was the most powerful bomb ever detonated.

vo.text: October 1961. The Soviets test the Tsar Bomba.
Fifty megatons. About fifteen hundred times Hiroshima and Nagasaki combined.
The fireball was eight kilometers wide. The cloud rose sixty-seven kilometers.
vo.cap: Fireball: *8 km* wide. Cloud: *67 km* high.

vo.text: Windows broke up to nine hundred kilometers away.
And this was the toned-down version. It was designed for over a hundred.
vo.cap: And it was *toned down.* Designed for *100+.*

vo.text: Would you have watched it from a hundred kilometers away? Tell me in the comments. And subscribe for more.

cta.q: Would you watch it from 100 km?
